coaching.headline: Willy's Belica owned the lobby. We leaked the middle objectives, then took Orb Prime and the whole damn base.
coaching.team: A proper win built on Belica's damage and Wukong's objective work. We took first blood and the first Fangtooth, then let the middle slip: they took the next two Fangtooths, and their Mini Prime fell with all five of us alive. After that Mini Prime they never took another major objective. Orb Prime led into an Inner Tower, the inhibitors and the core, and we finished ten structures to their one. The finish was clean; the middle was sloppy as hell.

focus.title: Answer every enemy objective
focus.action: When the enemy starts Fangtooth or Mini Prime and none of us is dead, one player calls contest or trade immediately and the team commits to it. Next game, count enemy majors that fall with all five alive and nothing taken back.

perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy put on a fucking clinic. Belica out-damaged everyone in the lobby by a mile, died once, and more than doubled his usual damage rate on the hero. Nothing there needs repair. The standard is the next layer: when her picks leave them a body down and a Fangtooth, Mini Prime or tower is reachable, Belica names it before hunting the next kill.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks did the grunt work that ends games: Wukong's objective damage beat the rest of our team combined, and his hero damage ran above his usual. The soft spot: he was dead both times they took Fangtooth, and a dead jungler at the pit is just an expensive farmer. When Fangtooth is about to spawn, Wukong calls the timer and the contest-or-trade choice before the next fight starts.
perPlayer.84d3231f-1ca1-4701-8d7f-c7133f7f03e9: Keep that shit. OasisTG07 made Murdock's night miserable, kept deleting Greystone, and still put the second-biggest objective damage on our side. Three deaths for a carry this involved is tidy, and all three came to Gideon, Iggy and Aurora. When one of those mages is unseen, Sparrow keeps Heightened Senses in reserve as her stealth exit before committing to a target.
perPlayer.3ac983bc-c000-403e-94c2-16bad9395206: Riktor did the support job properly. Most wards on our team, most wards cleared, the most damage soaked, a hand in close to half our kills, and a clean early duo lane. That is the job, done. The next standard is aimed at their real threat: Iggy & Scorch was their top damage and owned their only knockback. When Iggy sets up Inferno near our group, Riktor spends Riplash or Skewer on Iggy before peeling anyone else.
perPlayer.f8df0886-305c-4223-a0a0-d40b01e93bf1: No deaths, farm well above his usual, a big pile of healing and damage absorbed: Crunch built the safest offlane base on the board. Five assists across our 27 kills says the farm has not yet turned into team pressure on the scoreboard. When Wukong calls a Fangtooth or the team groups on a tower, Crunch shoves his wave first, then arrives with Right Crunch ready for the first enemy who reaches Belica or Sparrow.

12.4.call: Their Fangtooth fell in the same window as this teamfight, lost 2-3 with Wukong, Sparrow and Riktor dying. The timing does not show which came first.

19.2.call: Belica collected three kills in the same window as their Mini Prime, which fell with all five of us alive. Kill credits do not show who could reach the pit.

32.9.call: Belica and Wukong took two kills as their Inner Tower fell, and Orb Prime followed. The inhibitors and core went soon after. That is the finish to repeat: prize first, then the base.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.matchup: Belica faced Gideon, who built Azure Core, Tainted Scepter, Overseer and Dreambinder. Across the lobby, Iggy & Scorch, Gideon and Aurora made three magical threats, with Iggy dealing their most damage. Greystone was their sustain problem: the most healing in the lobby on a frontline body. Belica killed Gideon repeatedly, but the kill feed records the result, not how each pick was set up.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Combustion adds splash burst when abilities land, on a cooldown that shortens as she hits heroes. Noxia needs a second, separate ability to hit the marked target, so Seismic Assault into Void Bomb is the natural trigger. Wraith Leggings adds damage against low-health heroes, and Oblivion Crown multiplies her power. Caustica ignores part of magical armor and gains damage against bonus magical armor on healthy targets, which suits Aurora's Flux Matrix and Frostguard. Spellbreaker adds magical armor, and its spell shield raises her power while it holds.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Aion builds mana regeneration from casting and returns gold from spell damage to heroes, which suits a mage dealing this much hero damage; the gold it actually returned is not recorded. Bottomless Vial pays only for River Buffs Belica personally kills, so team river control does not confirm her stacks. Runic Focus rewards a high current mana percentage. Philosopher is the draft alternative for passive gold without the river requirement. Keep this loadout while Belica can reach river buffs safely.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience, a rotate-and-scale pick and the most common choice on Belica mid. Devastating Bombs pays off when Void Bomb catches isolated targets; Pulsefire Rounds adds damage to her basic attacks. Nothing in this game shows another augment would have done more. Keep Combat Veteran when rotations matter.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.crest: Soulbearer gives an active shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed, a defensive tool against Gideon's and Iggy's magical burst. The shield scales with power and mana, so it grows alongside Oblivion Crown. Its use is not recorded, so the one death cannot be credited to it or blamed on it.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.improvement: No swap is supported. If Greystone's healing starts outlasting her burst, a healing-reduction item would trade raw damage for that answer; here Greystone still died repeatedly, so it was not needed. If magical burst becomes the threat, Spellbreaker earlier in the order gives up some damage for safety. Otherwise this build is the standard to keep.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.matchup: Wukong's jungle opponent was Greystone, the lobby's top healer, who absorbed a huge amount of damage behind Draconum, Overlord and Rebirth. The gank targets were softer: Gideon, Murdock and Aurora all died repeatedly. Gideon got two of Wukong's three deaths and Iggy & Scorch the other. Three magical damage dealers are why the engine flags no magic resist on this build.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Manta Scythe speeds clearing and rewards hitting isolated enemies. Infernum's burn grows against bonus armor, relevant into Greystone's Draconum and Aurora's Elafrost and Frostguard. The Perforator adds armor penetration and a slow on ability damage. Tainted Trident applies healing reduction through any physical damage, the direct answer to Greystone's sustain, and Mesmer's spell shield blocks one incoming ability. Mesmer is not magical armor, so the flag stands, but it does answer a single big spell. Inventory does not prove when anti-heal came online.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Lotus periodically grants a random small bonus and adds more on takedowns; Early Bloom grants an extra level at its threshold, a useful experience bump for a jungler. Immaculate reduces damage only while Wukong is near full health, so it protects the opening of a fight, not the end. Masterpiece is the draft alternative for kill-chaining bonuses; Prima Donna adds damage but makes him take more. With deaths before both enemy Fangtooths, this game gives no reason to trade safety for damage.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.augment: Masterful Mimicry raises the clone cap and generates Hair passively, so clones arrive more often in long fights and on objectives. That fits a Wukong who spent the game hitting objectives; clone damage itself is not recorded. From Up High rewards high slams and Prosperous Path adds kill gold or healing by stance. Keep Mimicry.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.crest: Nex is a short dash that damages and slows nearby heroes, growing with damage Wukong stored from recent hits. It works as engage or chase. Spending it to enter removes it as an exit, which matters when Gideon or Iggy can still hit him. Active use is not recorded.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.improvement: If Iggy's or Gideon's magical damage keeps landing first, a magical-armor item in the last slot trades some offense for staying alive into the next objective. Mesmer already blocks one spell, so this is conditional, not a correction. Keep Tainted Trident whenever a healing jungler like Greystone is sustaining through fights; it is Wukong's only anti-heal.

f8df0886-305c-4223-a0a0-d40b01e93bf1.matchup: Crunch faced Aurora, who built Magnify, Elafrost, Frostguard and Flux Matrix and leaned on control and damage absorption; she died three times and never killed Crunch. Across their team, three magical damage sources were the threat to a melee diver, with Iggy & Scorch leading their damage. Crunch was never killed, so the matchup did not punish the build; it also does not show how often he reached their backline.
f8df0886-305c-4223-a0a0-d40b01e93bf1.build: Volcanica shortens his other cooldowns on each cast, feeding Crunch's ability-chained kit. Crystalline Cuirass stacks magical armor while taking magical damage, a direct answer to three magical threats. Vyzar Carapace adds damage and a shield after repeated hits on a hero. Mutilator adds maximum-health damage, with extra applications from ability hits, and Earthshaker ramps ability damage, faster for melee heroes. It leans more defensive than the common Augmentation, Mutilator and Salvation core. The deathless result fits that choice but does not prove it.
f8df0886-305c-4223-a0a0-d40b01e93bf1.eternal: Pilow weakens nearby enemies' damage each time Crunch casts, and Neurotoxin makes those same enemies take more damage, so a busy-casting Crunch protects and amplifies at once. Harmonic Currents returns missing health and mana on cast. Pilow is the field's second choice on Crunch offlane, well behind Thraex; its value depends on fighting close to several enemies. Keep it when Crunch is the frontline the team fights around.
f8df0886-305c-4223-a0a0-d40b01e93bf1.augment: Combo Crunch turns Cross Crunch hits into attack speed and is the most-picked option by a distance. It rewards long exchanges. Lunge Crunch extends Forward Crunch's reach, a draft option if reaching the backline becomes the problem; nothing in this game shows that it was. Keep it.
f8df0886-305c-4223-a0a0-d40b01e93bf1.crest: Iceskorn Talons drops an ice sheet that gives allies on it physical power and movement speed while slowing enemies. Sparrow and Wukong benefit most when the fight happens on it. It is a positioning tool, and its use and occupancy are not recorded.
f8df0886-305c-4223-a0a0-d40b01e93bf1.improvement: No swap is supported by zero deaths with this much damage absorbed. If the next game asks Crunch to finish their carry rather than outlast their offlaner, Augmentation in place of Earthshaker trades some ability damage for faster empowered attacks. Otherwise keep the defensive shape.

84d3231f-1ca1-4701-8d7f-c7133f7f03e9.matchup: Sparrow and Riktor faced Murdock and Iggy & Scorch. Murdock died five times, three of them to Sparrow. Iggy was their top damage dealer and owned their only knockback, the Inferno belch, while Aurora's freeze added a stun. Greystone was the other recurring target, killed by Sparrow four times. The duo read came out ours: first Fangtooth went to us and only their duo died before ten minutes.
84d3231f-1ca1-4701-8d7f-c7133f7f03e9.build: Storm Breaker charges while moving and attacking, then releases chain lightning that applies on-hit effects. Tainted Rounds adds healing reduction on basic attacks and more damage as targets drop, the direct tool against Greystone's healing. Equinox shields her when she falls low and adds tenacity against crowd control. Vanquisher executes heroes at a sliver of health, Imperator strengthens critical strikes, and Dust Devil ramps attack speed while hitting heroes. Skipping Sky Splitter and Spectra from the common core did not visibly cost damage. Inventory does not show when each effect came online.
84d3231f-1ca1-4701-8d7f-c7133f7f03e9.eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles when Sparrow damages a low-health hero, matching a finisher's job alongside Vanquisher. Forage adds gold and experience from farm; Wind-Rider grants attack speed after a dash or leaving stealth, which Heightened Senses provides. This is the field's dominant Sparrow pairing. Taproot is the alternative if sustain in long trades becomes the problem; it trades Wind-Rider's attack-speed burst for on-hit healing.
84d3231f-1ca1-4701-8d7f-c7133f7f03e9.augment: Endless Hunt resets her basic ability cooldowns on takedowns and adds permanent physical penetration, so it scales with the kind of takedown-heavy game this was. Sun Shards, the most-picked option, spreads basic attacks across nearby targets; Inner Fury widens her ultimate. Keep Endless Hunt while takedowns come this often.
84d3231f-1ca1-4701-8d7f-c7133f7f03e9.crest: Eviscerator is an active burst of attack speed, omnivamp and on-hit damage, a commitment tool for a duel or a siege. The omnivamp also helps her outlast Iggy's damage once she is committed. Its use is not recorded, so neither her kills nor her deaths can be tied to it.
84d3231f-1ca1-4701-8d7f-c7133f7f03e9.improvement: Keep the core. If Iggy & Scorch keeps landing magical damage on her first, a defensive slot in place of Dust Devil trades some attack speed for survival. Against a jungler without heavy healing, Tainted Rounds becomes the slot to trade for raw damage such as Sky Splitter. This game supports neither change.

3ac983bc-c000-403e-94c2-16bad9395206.matchup: Riktor supported Sparrow into Murdock and Iggy & Scorch. Iggy was their top damage dealer, magical, running Caustica, Tainted Scepter and Megacosm, and owned their only knockback. Greystone was the other sustained threat around the duo. Three magical sources are why the engine flags no magic resist on Riktor's build.
3ac983bc-c000-403e-94c2-16bad9395206.build: Tainted Guard punishes basic attackers with healing reduction and a bleed, useful when Greystone or Murdock hits him. Elafrost empowers a basic attack after each cast with an area slow, Gaia Greaves builds movement into a burst hit, and Spectra and Overlord add attack-based damage. It is a durable physical-armor build with no magical armor, against a lobby whose top damage was magical. Inventory does not show what each item contributed.
3ac983bc-c000-403e-94c2-16bad9395206.eternal: Krix grows maximum health; Regenerative Tissue regenerates after a break from hero damage, and Cannibalism adds permanent health on takedowns, which a support involved in this many kills collects steadily. Krix is also the field's most common pick on Riktor support. Festering Wounds is the alternative to Regenerative Tissue if the team needs anti-heal through his immobilizes; that gives up recovery between trades.
3ac983bc-c000-403e-94c2-16bad9395206.augment: Wanton Warden heals Riktor for part of the damage he takes, matching a game where he absorbed more than anyone on our side. It is the field's most common support pick. Warden's Leash, which hooks allies, is the swap only if repositioning teammates becomes the main need. Keep it.
3ac983bc-c000-403e-94c2-16bad9395206.crest: Leafsong's Phantom Rush gives nearby allies movement speed, slow immunity and the ability to pass through heroes, for a chase or an escape. It also raises the ward cap, which fits a support who placed the most wards on our side. Its minion gold diminishes, so it rewards staying off the waves. Active use is not recorded.
3ac983bc-c000-403e-94c2-16bad9395206.improvement: A magical-armor item in place of Spectra or Gaia Greaves is the one change this lobby argues for: their top damage was magical and Riktor took the most damage on our side. It costs attack-based damage. Keep Tainted Guard while Greystone and Murdock are the ones basic-attacking him.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s), Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Riktor) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
ourKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
ourKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
ourKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

ourKits.combo: Windsurge engage → Cyclebreaker damage-reduction spin → clones from 84000 Hairs
ourKits.winCondition: stance-dance for damage or tankiness and overwhelm with clones
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights alongside his clones
ourKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; CC him during the damage-reduction window

ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
ourKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down
